body:
First pass done. Full audit doc in #2937; the deliverable table is below.

Five parallel auditors covered `ui/view`, `ui/chart`+dashboard/report, `ui/page`+`ui/component`, field types + filter operators, and the peripheral UI enums. Every row was read off the dispatch code; the highest-stakes claims were then independently re-verified in source. Nothing was exercised at runtime, so symptoms are read off the code path, not observed.

## The premise was inverted

This issue described `ChartTypeSchema` as a 7-value spec enum that `plugin-charts` had outgrown with 13 renderer-local names. It's the reverse. The spec enum has **19** values (`ui/chart.zod.ts:18`). The 7-value list is an **objectui fork** — `packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts:209` — re-exported from `@object-ui/types` under *the same symbol name the spec uses*. Two packages export `ChartTypeSchema`; they differ by twelve values.

That inversion turned out to be the audit's most useful result, because it generalises: the failure is rarely "renderer forgot a name". It is usually **"a second definition of the vocabulary exists, and the renderer is faithful to the wrong one."** Five such forks found — tracked in #2944.

## Numbers

| | |
|---|---|
| Named enum exports in spec `ui/` | 30 |
| …with a real consumer outside `packages/types` | **11** |
| …named only in a `packages/types` deny-list or local fork | 14 |
| …with zero mentions anywhere in the repo | 5 |
| Direction A gaps with a user-visible defect | **24** |
| …plus inert ones (validate, change nothing) | 11 |
| Surfaces carrying renderer-local dialect | 10 |
| Enum-value parity guards in the repo | **1** |

The middle number is the structural one: **19 of 30 UI vocabularies have nothing mechanically tying them to the spec.** That measures *derivation*, not coverage — `VisualizationTypeSchema` obviously has a renderer, it just restates the nine values instead of importing them. Drift there is unpoliced by construction, which explains why these went unreported rather than why they exist.

## Triage: by runtime symptom, not by direction

Direction A/B turned out to be the wrong axis for sequencing. What the user *sees* orders the work by how long a defect survives undetected.

| Tier | Count | Symptom | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | 6 | Silently **wrong** output — worse than #2897. `PivotTable.tsx:114` returns a **sum** for `count_distinct`; `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx:370` silently draws a **bar chart** for 10 of 19 types. A blank cell is detectable; a plausible wrong number is not. | #2941 |
| **2** | 15 | Silently **absent** — the #2897 shape. Includes `element: 'toggle'` deleting the entire filter bar, and 6 of 9 animation presets doing nothing because `useAnimation.ts:64` keys its lookup in hyphens where the spec enum uses underscores. | #2942 |
| **3** | 3 | **Loud** red box. Cheapest to triage precisely because it cannot hide — includes `ai:chat_window`, which Studio offers in the palette *with a config panel* and which has no renderer. | #2943 |
| **4** | 11 | **Inert** — validates, changes nothing. Live the moment anyone wires the surface up. | #2945 |

Two upstream tracks: **#2944** (retire the five forks — all inert today, and already-settled #2231 policy) and **#2945** (consolidate the spec-side vocabularies: nine disagreeing filter-operator enums, two chart-type enums, `ActionType` vs `WidgetActionTypeSchema`). **#2945 is upstream of most of the renderer work** — no filter-builder fix is durable until there is one answer to "what is a filter operator".

## The sharpest single finding

`ui/view.zod.ts:315` says of `toggle`: *"Kept in the enum so existing configs keep rendering; do not author new `toggle` filters."*

`plugin-list/src/UserFilters.tsx:162` returns `null` for it — the whole filter bar vanishes. The component's own docstring at `:122` advertises *"**toggle**: on/off toggle buttons per field"*.

Three artifacts describe one value. The only one that executes is the one that says nothing.

## Already fixed

#2940 ships the two items that needed no design decision:

- **`$ncontains`** — `FilterConditionField.tsx:114` emitted a token appearing **zero times** in the spec, which objectui's own `convertFiltersToAST` throws on while naming the correct spelling (`$notContains`) in its error message. Every "does not contain" sharing rule validated in the UI and was rejected downstream.
- **`secret` inline-editable as plaintext** — in neither `EDIT_WIDGETS` nor `INLINE_EXCLUDED_FIELD_TYPES`, two lines from `password`, which is correctly excluded. Per ADR-0100 a `secret` is encrypted-at-rest and fail-closed.

Adding `secret` tripped the exclusion-set staleness guard, which is itself mis-specified in the way this issue predicts: it treats `Object.keys(fieldWidgetMap)` as the set of real field types, but spec spellings reaching a widget through the alias table (`secret` → `field:password`) aren't keys.

## Why the existing guards can't see any of this

The repo has a mature drift-guard doctrine for schema **shape** (#2231 — three tests in `packages/types`) and exactly **one** guard for enum-value renderer **coverage** (`summary-spec-parity.test.ts`, from #2897). `list-view-spec-parity.test.ts` asserts field *keys*, not enum *values*, so none of the drift above trips it.

Two tests that look like coverage guards aren't:

- `fields/src/field-type-coverage.test.ts:19` hard-codes its expected list instead of importing `FieldType` — which is exactly why the `autonumber` display-map gap survived.
- `block-config.test.ts:26` asserts palette *exclusions* by hand rather than deriving inclusion from `PageComponentType`, locking drift in instead of detecting it.

The #2897 template ports without new machinery — `.options` reads cleanly through the `lazySchema` wrapper on every enum tested. One prerequisite: of the 13 packages that would need a guard, **6 cannot import the spec today** (`plugin-list`, `plugin-charts`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-report`, `components`, `mobile` lack the `@objectstack/spec` devDependency).

## Suggested sequencing

1. ~~The two clear bugs~~ — #2940.
2. **#2945** — consolidate spec-side vocabularies while 16 is still RC. After GA, retiring a name is breaking.
3. **#2944** — retire the five forks. Mechanical, and inert today.
4. **#2941** (Tier 1), then **#2942** (Tier 2), guarding each pair as it's fixed.
5. **#2943** and the enforce-or-remove calls in #2945.

## The consolidation issue this audit spawned is closed — #2945

Leaving a pointer here since #2945 was the vehicle for acting on this audit's findings, and it is now fully dispositioned.

**What the audit's findings turned into:**

| Finding class | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Orphan vocabularies with zero consumers | deleted — objectstack-ai/objectstack#4061 |
| Enums narrower than what the renderers implement | widened — objectstack-ai/objectstack#4070 (`combo`, `WidgetActionType` = `ActionType`, list-chart subset `.extract`ed, lint's chart set derived) |
| Renderer-local operator dialects | all three tables pinned to the spec with parity guards — #2974, #2940, #2989, #3022 |
| A renderer prop the spec never declared | `InlineActionSchema` — objectstack-ai/objectstack#4135, producers migrated in objectstack-ai/cloud#926, Studio can author it in #3028 |
| One vocabulary in three unguarded places | derived + guarded — objectstack-ai/objectstack#4153 |
| The silent-drop this audit found while tracing operators | fixed and verified, objectstack-ai/objectstack#3948 closed |
| Vocabulary *narrowing* (Track C items 1–3) | ⛔ not planned — the harms they were preconditions for are all fixed by cheaper means |

**The audit's own most useful output, in hindsight**, was not the enum inventory — it was the discovery that a name validating but not rendering is only half the problem. The other half, which cost more to fix, was names the renderer *implements* that the spec never admits (`combo`, `form` on widget actions, `element:button.action`), because those fail in the direction nothing checks: valid metadata rejected at save, or authored metadata silently stripped.

Two follow-ups still open, both narrower than this audit: objectstack-ai/objectstack#4121 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#4157.

Whether this audit issue should stay open is a call for whoever owns it — the enum ↔ renderer sweep it describes is broader than what #2945 acted on.

**分诊:关闭(completed)—— 本单的交付物已经交付,且全部后继单已闭环。** 维护者可否决重开(否决窗口,同 step 8 模式)。

## 依据:本单自己定义的交付物是「表,不是修复」

正文原话:「The deliverable for a first pass is **the table, not the fixes**」。那张表已在 2026-07-28 的评论里交付(审计文档 #2937,五个并行审计员覆盖 `ui/view`、`ui/chart`+dashboard/report、`ui/page`+`ui/component`、字段类型+过滤算子、外围 UI 枚举),并给出了完整读数:30 个 spec `ui/` 具名枚举、11 个有 `packages/types` 之外的真实消费方、**19/30 与 spec 之间没有任何机械绑定**、24 条有用户可见缺陷的 Direction A 缺口、10 个带渲染器方言的面。

正文第 3 步要求的分级(triage before fixing)也做了,而且**换了更好的轴**:按运行期症状(错值 / 静默缺失 / 红框 / 惰性)而不是按 A/B 方向排序。

## 后继单状态(本轮逐条核过 —— ⛔ 不取最后一条评论的字面,自己查了 state)

| 单 | 内容 | 状态 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #2941 | Tier 1 静默**错值**(6 条) | **closed / completed** |
| #2942 | Tier 2 静默**缺失**(15 条) | **closed / completed** |
| #2943 | Tier 3 **红框**(3 条) | **closed / completed** |
| #2944 | 退役五个影子 spec 符号名的 objectui fork | **closed / completed** |
| #2945 | spec 侧词汇收敛(含 Track C 1–3 的 not planned 裁决) | **closed / completed** |
| #2997 / #3014 | 审计衍生的两条独立缺陷 | **closed / completed** |

⇒ 七条后继全部闭环,**无一悬空**。#2940 早已带走两个无需设计决策的即时修复(`$ncontains` 拼写、`secret` 内联明文可编辑)。

## 为什么现在关而不是继续持有

最后一条评论把这个问题明确交给了 owner:「Whether this audit issue should stay open is a call for whoever owner it — the enum ↔ renderer sweep it describes is broader than what #2945 acted on」。分诊的判断是**关**,理由是发现分诊轮的纪律(#4949:发现的准确性半衰期以天计,囤积是负利息存款):

- 本单已 **9 天**无新动作,而它记录的读数(行号、枚举取值、fork 清单)在 #2941–#2945 的修复落地后**已被大面积改写** —— 继续持有的是一份**已经过时的地图**,任何人捡起来都必须重新审计一遍,而重新审计不需要这张旧表;
- 「sweep 比 #2945 实际动的范围更广」这句是对的,但它描述的是**下一次审计**,不是本单的未竟部分。真要做,应基于**今天的 main** 重新立单,⛔ 不是让一份 7 月 28 日的清单继续挂着冒充待办;
- 两条仍开的窄口径后继(objectstack#4121、objectstack#4157)**各自独立在册**,不依赖本单存活。

## 本单最有价值的一条结论(留档,不随关单丢失)

审计推翻了本单**自己的前提**:`ChartTypeSchema` 不是「7 值 spec 被 13 值渲染器超出」,而是反过来 —— spec 有 **19** 值,那份 7 值清单是 objectui 的 **fork**(`packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts:209`),**用与 spec 相同的符号名再导出**。由此得出的一般化结论值得比这张表活得更久:

> 失效模式很少是「渲染器忘了一个名字」,通常是「**这套词汇存在第二份定义,而渲染器忠实于错的那一份**」。

以及那条最锋利的观察:`toggle` 一个值被三份工件描述(spec 说保留兼容、组件 docstring 说提供开关按钮、代码 `return null`),**唯一会执行的是什么都不说的那一份**。

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine(#5474 试点),不构成认领。
